$comment: D4.47 — Final-Clause Coherence and Evidence Coverage. What was required, what was done, the evidence, and what remains open.

Measured on 16 October 2026 against commit 39422d779 (D4.46) plus the D4.47 working tree. The term sheet stays withdrawn. Nothing here is a legal approval; the survival semantics and the reworded findings are draft-needs-legal-review.
review_status: engineering — survival semantics await advocate review

items.requirement: A document shown without a blocking issue can be downloaded.
items.found: Export re-validates in 'final' mode; the AI safety layer runs there for any AI-touched or edited draft and never ran in what the user was shown. Its tamper heuristics flagged the engine's own '(iii)', 'Schedule III' and '(a) In full and final settlement'; an unchanged draft had every clause judged as an edit; a model's verdict blocked. 18 of 58 corpus documents refused once AI-touched, two of them shown 'Automated checks passed' at 100. In production the AI path is the default, so this hit real users.
done: IRE/src/indian-rule-engine/aiLegalSafetyValidator.js: Roman numerals and leading enumerators are drafting; a token or lowercase opening already in the drafted text was not introduced by an edit; an unchanged draft has nothing judged; the drafted text is the immutable pre-AI text where the AI tailored.
A model's verdict (integrity or legal) is 'Requires legal review', verified_authority false; deterministic tampering still blocks.
frontend Editor.jsx: a refused export lists only the blocking findings and links each to its clause; the explanation no longer says export needs zero open issues.
items.verified_by: tests/exportParity.test.mjs (20 checks; 174 exports across plain, AI-touched and edited drafts)

items.requirement: Final clause set and final survival wording agree; survival is a drafting decision, not a consequence of a title.
done: knowledge-base/metadata/survival_semantics.json names each survival-bearing clause by id and records 20 clauses a title would have pulled in (termination notice, notice period, licences, data security, return of information ...) with the reason each does not survive.

documentService.finaliseSurvivalReferences: the clauses that enumerate surviving provisions are rendered again as the last stage, from the final clause set, on every path (generation, repair, AI merge).
survivalSemantics.verifySurvivalReferences on every validation: SURVIVAL_REFERENCES_MISMATCH (Requires legal review) when the printed list omits a surviving provision present or names one absent.
items.verified_by: tests/survivalReferences.test.mjs (16 checks; all 58 documents agree and the list is a fixed point)

items.requirement: Every mutation entry point, including export-time transformations, is guarded; the guard protects meaning, not only numbers.
done: knowledge-base/governance/mutation-paths.json lists the 6 paths; the test checks each against the code.
Two were unguarded: chat edits (applied in the browser) and export-time quality controls. Both now pass the guard (backend/services/mutationEntryPoints.js).
For AI changes the guard reads negation, obligation words, conditions and exceptions, remedies, parties (from the identity clause) and numbers in words.
Gaps recorded and asserted: scope quantifiers, temporal order, standards of conduct, subject matter.
DOCX fidelity: every figure in the draft text is in the exported DOCX on all 58 drafts. PDF not verified (no extractor).

items.requirement: A document with a blocking contradiction and missing information shows Blocked and keeps the missing-information finding in its report.
A warning does not conclude a legal result without a verified basis.
done: USURIOUS_INTEREST_RATE: says section 3 lets a court reopen excessive interest, that this is not a finding of usury, and that the rate was not changed; no '24%' limit is suggested; Requires legal review.

still_open: NORMALISATION_NOT_IDEMPOTENT (P1): three clauses ship role words their documents never define (NDA 'Recipient', Software Development 'Licensor'/'Licensee'); a second normalisation would break the loan's 'Principal sum'.
Held BLOCK requirements (11): visible as Requires legal review; activation waits for applicability and satisfier evidence.
MOU binding/non-binding classification, Employment POSH coverage, Rental possession: advocate decisions.
Six-field evidence records for each generation and quality level.
Meaning-guard gaps listed in mutation-paths.json; PDF export fidelity.
The 16 failing suites remain tracked; the suite is not fully passing.
